data.name: Mech Believe MEGA BRAWL!!
data.detailed_description:
A 3D action roguelike about kids playing with toys! Construct your own robot to take into battle against rival toys, and fight through multiple waves to come out on top. As you progress, unlock a variety of new robot parts and stickers that you can equip to give you powerful new abilities!

BUILD!!

Dig through your toy bin and grab parts to assemble your very own toy robot! Each robot part has its own unique set of abilities for you to use in combat, and change the way you play! Then, apply power-up stickers onto your hand to provide your robot with a variety of special buffs in battle! Gather from a total of 12 different robot parts and 12 different stickers, and watch your collection grow!

BRAWL!!

Drop into the play arena with your robot, and use your robot’s various attacks to blast and punch your way through the opposition: toy cars, soldiers, dinos, and more! Make your way through several rounds of increasingly challenging enemies before culminating in a final boss fight with the biggest, baddest robot around!

BELIEVE!!

You play as Fleck, the new kid at school, who is a huge robot nerd, and wants to participate in the school-wide MEGA BRAWL!! With the help of your equally enthusiastic teacher Mr. Fairwell and the class’s pet hamster Sophie, master the art of mech believing and channel your imagination through your toy in order to come out on top and defeat your foes, including the spoiled-rich bully: Bentley.
